items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: We had a jam session. The play was wonderful.

ctx.x: Yeah, I knew he studied some piano.

And there's another kid I got. He's 14 or 15 now. Jimmy Butler up in Columbus, Indiana. We had him in. We brought him in. His mother let him come in. We picked him up at the train. We had a jam session. The play was wonderful.
Tell me, I'm not trying to embarrass you or anything, but did you ever learn to read any at all much?
